meta.notes: PhotoshopEX, 2026-10-27: Krea 2 Turbo has no inpainting model, so this is noise-mask inpainting on the text-to-image model, plan-native-engine §9's cheap first step. The loaders, the krea2 CLIPLoader, the zeroed negative and the 8-step euler/simple sampler are ComfyUI's official 'Text to Image (Krea-2 Turbo)' template (image_krea2_turbo_t2i.json, as krea2-turbo/image); the picture and its mask enter as in the 2511 fill templates (LoadImage, VAEEncode, LoadImage → ImageToMask red → SetLatentNoiseMask) in place of EmptyLatentImage. The prompt describes the new content as it is. Node names verified against the local server's /object_info (ComfyUI 0.39). Not a default under auto.
